title: About us
intro: A small furniture studio in Ghent, making pieces for homes that are lived in.

blocks.title: We make furniture the long way round
blocks.text: What began as a single workbench in a garage is now a workshop of seven makers. The approach hasn't changed: good wood, honest joints, no shortcuts.
blocks.credit: Photo by Adam Patterson on Unsplash

blocks.title: Wood with a story we can trace

content.text: Our oak and walnut come from sawmills in the Ardennes and northern France that we have worked with for years. We buy whole boards, let them rest for months and use the offcuts for stools and small pieces.

blocks.credit: Photo by The Cleveland Museum of Art on Unsplash

blocks.title: Finished by hand, repaired for life

content.text: Every surface is sanded and oiled by hand: three coats, with a day of rest in between. If something ever needs attention, bring it back. We repair everything we make, for as long as we're around.

blocks.credit: Photo by Dominik Scythe on Unsplash

link.label: Why we still oil our oak by hand

blocks.quote: We would rather make a hundred tables that last fifty years than a thousand that last five.
blocks.author: Maya Janssens

blocks.title: Letters from the workshop
blocks.text: A short note every season: new pieces, workshop open days and the occasional story about wood.
blocks.note: No spam. Unsubscribe at any time.
